title: Water Damage Mitigation Emergency Service Call Charging Clause
content:
**Dispatch billing clause — Water Damage Mitigation**

1. The job must be in dispatched, authorized or drying status when a service call is charged.
2. Every dispatch to a job, the first one and any return dispatch the customer books, is charged the service call fee of the job's tier, increased by the after-hours surcharge when the dispatch falls in the after-hours window or by the holiday surcharge when it falls in the holiday window; the holiday surcharge replaces the after-hours surcharge and the two never stack.
3. The service call fee is not charged when the crew's recorded arrival time exceeds the arrival commitment of the job's tier.
4. The service call fee is also not charged when, on the dispatch date, the customer holds a Commercial & Property Manager Service Agreement in active status whose tier carries the service call fee waiver entitlement of that charter.
5. A waived service call is simply not booked; a waiver never creates a negative line, and the two waivers do not combine into any further credit.
6. Amounts are rounded to the cent, half up.

## The charged amount
The charge for one dispatch is the tier's service call fee multiplied by one plus the applicable surcharge percentage taken as a fraction, rounded to the cent, half up. A business-hours dispatch carries no surcharge.

| Rate window of the dispatch | Surcharge applied |
|---|---|
| Business hours | none |
| After hours | the tier's after-hours surcharge |
| Holiday | the tier's holiday surcharge only (never together with the after-hours surcharge) |

## Worked figures (hypothetical fee of $200.00, surcharges of 35 and 60 percent)
- Business-hours dispatch: $200.00.
- After-hours dispatch: $200.00 multiplied by 1.35, giving $270.00.
- Holiday dispatch: $200.00 multiplied by 1.60, giving $320.00.

## Arrival commitment, both sides
The comparison uses the crew's recorded arrival time in minutes from the call, on the job record. With a commitment of 120 minutes, a recorded arrival of 120 minutes does not exceed the commitment and the fee is charged; a recorded arrival of 121 minutes exceeds it and the fee is not charged.

## Service agreement waiver
The waiver turns on the customer's Commercial & Property Manager Service Agreement as it stood on the dispatch date: the agreement must be in active status and its tier must carry the service call fee waiver entitlement of that charter. Where either waiver applies the service call is not booked at all.
